name: Flurrying Darkness
source:
Sierra and her friend Julian are trapped inside of a little cabin.

The snow outside had turned black. That, if touched, would strip you of your humanity and leave you a senseless monster. The two observe the affected world around them. 

Julian had sworn to protect her. But maybe there’s something he secretly knows... 

[From [url=https://resinleaf.itch.io/fluttering-darkness]itch.io[/url]]
